name: 98374 · Puyallup, WA
findings: ZIP 98374 (Puyallup) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98374 (Puyallup) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98374 (Puyallup) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
